pins.name: D2
pins.label: GPIO2 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED0 - "Debug LED 1" near the USB connector, shared w/ header. Confirmed active-high via github.com/DatanoiseTV/PicoADK-Hardware GettingStarted_Arduino.md: digitalWrite(PIN_LED0, 1) turns it on.

pins.name: D3
pins.label: GPIO3 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED1 - "Debug LED 2" near the USB connector, shared w/ header. Polarity inferred to match PIN_LED0 (GPIO2), same debug-LED bank - not independently confirmed per-pin.

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes:
PIN_SPI0_MISO / PIN_I2S_DOUT - dedicated I2S data line to the onboard PCM5102/PCM5100A audio codec. No static-const alias in this board's pins_arduino.h; entry added for documentation.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO17
pins.label: GPIO17
pins.notes:
PIN_SPI0_SS / PIN_I2S_BCLK - dedicated I2S bit-clock line to the onboard audio codec. No static-const alias in this board's pins_arduino.h; entry added for documentation.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO18
pins.label: GPIO18
pins.notes:
PIN_SPI0_SCK / PIN_I2S_LRCLK - dedicated I2S word-select (LR clock) line to the onboard audio codec. No static-const alias in this board's pins_arduino.h; entry added for documentation.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO19
pins.label: GPIO19
pins.notes:
PIN_SPI0_MOSI - 4th wire of the SPI0 peripheral block reused for I2S above (GPIO16-18). Not separately named in the vendor's own I2S signal list (playback-only DAC has no DIN need), but grouped here with the rest of the reused SPI0 block per this board's own pins_arduino.h comment, which already excludes it (no D19 alias declared).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO23

pins.notes:
